summary.en: A stable path to scaling window-based vision transformers to three billion parameters and high-resolution inputs
summary.zh: 将窗口式视觉 Transformer 稳定扩展到 30 亿参数和高分辨率输入的方法

displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 稳定扩展大规模视觉 Transformer

description.en:
Swin Transformer V2 addressed three obstacles that appeared when vision transformers were scaled up: unstable optimization, a mismatch between low-resolution pretraining and high-resolution downstream tasks, and heavy dependence on labeled images. It combined residual post-normalization with scaled cosine attention, introduced log-spaced continuous position bias for resolution transfer, and used SimMIM self-supervised pretraining.

The resulting system scaled to 3 billion parameters and images as large as 1536 x 1536, while reporting strong results on ImageNet-V2, COCO, ADE20K and Kinetics-400.
description.zh:
Swin Transformer V2 针对视觉 Transformer 扩大规模后出现的三个障碍：优化不稳定、低分辨率预训练与高分辨率下游任务之间的落差，以及对标注图像的高度依赖。它把残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力结合起来，引入对数间隔的连续位置偏置来支持分辨率迁移，并采用 SimMIM 自监督预训练。

这套方法把模型扩展到 30 亿参数，并可处理最高 1536 x 1536 分辨率的图像，同时在 ImageNet-V2、COCO、ADE20K 和 Kinetics-400 上报告了强劲结果。

text.en: Swin Transformer V2 combines residual post-normalization and scaled cosine attention for stability, log-spaced continuous position bias for resolution transfer, and SimMIM pretraining to reduce labeled-data demand.
text.zh: Swin Transformer V2 使用残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力提升稳定性，以对数间隔连续位置偏置支持分辨率迁移，并用 SimMIM 预训练降低对标注数据的需求。

text.en: The paper reports a 3-billion-parameter model, inputs up to 1536 x 1536, and results across ImageNet-V2, COCO, ADE20K and Kinetics-400.
text.zh: 论文报告了 30 亿参数模型、最高 1536 x 1536 的输入分辨率，以及在 ImageNet-V2、COCO、ADE20K 和 Kinetics-400 上的结果。

html.en: By 2021, hierarchical window-based transformers had made transformer backbones practical for mainstream vision tasks, but simply enlarging them exposed optimization and resolution-transfer problems. Swin Transformer V2 was designed to make the architecture scale in both parameter count and input resolution without demanding an impractical amount of labeled data.
html.zh: 到 2021 年，分层窗口式 Transformer 已让 Transformer 主干能够用于主流视觉任务，但直接扩大模型会暴露优化不稳定和分辨率迁移困难。Swin Transformer V2 的目标是在参数量与输入分辨率上同时扩展，并避免依赖难以承受的大规模标注数据。

html.en: Residual post-normalization and scaled cosine attention make very large Swin blocks easier to optimize. Log-spaced continuous position bias transfers spatial relationships from smaller pretraining windows to larger downstream windows, while SimMIM supplies self-supervised pretraining before task-specific adaptation.
html.zh: 残差后归一化与缩放余弦注意力让超大规模 Swin 模块更易于优化。对数间隔连续位置偏置把较小预训练窗口中的空间关系迁移到更大的下游窗口，SimMIM 则在任务适配前提供自监督预训练。

html.en: Experts generally treat Swin Transformer V2 as an important engineering and architectural refinement of the original Swin family rather than a wholly separate vision paradigm. Its lasting contribution is the coordinated treatment of optimization stability, position-bias transfer and self-supervised pretraining, which made billion-scale high-resolution vision experiments more reproducible through an openly released implementation.
html.zh: 专家通常把 Swin Transformer V2 视为原始 Swin 系列的重要工程与架构改进，而不是完全独立的视觉范式。它的长期贡献在于协同处理优化稳定性、位置偏置迁移和自监督预训练，并通过公开实现提高十亿参数级高分辨率视觉实验的可复现性。

summary.en: A simple masked image modeling framework built from random masks, raw-pixel regression and a lightweight prediction head
summary.zh: 以随机遮挡、原始像素回归和轻量预测头构成的简洁掩码图像建模框架

displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 简洁的掩码图像预训练

description.en:
SimMIM asked how much machinery masked image modeling actually needed. Instead of block-wise masking, discrete-VAE tokenizers, clustering targets or a heavy decoder, it used random masks with moderately large patches, directly regressed the RGB values of masked pixels and reduced the prediction head to a linear layer.

The simple recipe produced strong representations with both ViT and Swin backbones, and the paper reports scaling from ViT-B to a 3-billion-parameter SwinV2-G model.
description.zh:
SimMIM 追问掩码图像建模究竟需要多少复杂机制。它不依赖分块遮挡、离散 VAE 分词器、聚类目标或沉重解码器，而是采用中等偏大的随机遮挡块，直接回归被遮挡位置的 RGB 像素值，并把预测头简化为单个线性层。

这套简洁方案在 ViT 与 Swin 主干上都学到强表征，论文还报告了从 ViT-B 扩展到 30 亿参数 SwinV2-G 的结果。

text.en: SimMIM uses random masking with moderately large patches, direct regression of raw RGB pixel values and a lightweight linear prediction head, without requiring a discrete tokenizer or clustering target.
text.zh: SimMIM 采用中等偏大的随机遮挡块、原始 RGB 像素值直接回归和轻量线性预测头，不需要离散分词器或聚类目标。

text.en: The paper reports 83.8% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with ViT-B, 87.1% with the roughly 650-million-parameter SwinV2-H, and a 3-billion-parameter SwinV2-G trained with far less labeled data than the cited prior practice.
text.zh: 论文报告 ViT-B 在 ImageNet-1K 上达到 83.8% top-1，约 6.5 亿参数的 SwinV2-H 达到 87.1%，并以明显更少的标注数据训练 30 亿参数 SwinV2-G。

html.en: Masked image modeling emerged as a way to bring self-supervised pretraining ideas from language models into computer vision, but early systems often introduced tokenizers, clustering targets or substantial decoder machinery. SimMIM tested whether those additions were essential and deliberately reduced the task to a small set of controllable design choices.
html.zh: 掩码图像建模把语言模型中的自监督预训练思路带入计算机视觉，但早期系统往往加入分词器、聚类目标或较重的解码结构。SimMIM 直接检验这些机制是否必要，并把任务压缩为少量可控设计选择。

html.en: The input image is randomly masked with moderately large patches, and the visible content is processed by a standard vision backbone. A lightweight linear head predicts the raw RGB values of masked pixels, making the reconstruction target simple enough that representation quality can be studied without confounding tokenizer or decoder complexity.
html.zh: 输入图像先以中等偏大的图块随机遮挡，可见内容再交给标准视觉主干处理。轻量线性头直接预测被遮挡像素的原始 RGB 值，使研究者可以在不受复杂分词器或解码器干扰的情况下观察表征质量。

html.en: Experts generally treat SimMIM as evidence that strong masked-image pretraining does not require elaborate discrete targets or a heavy reconstruction stack. Its lasting value is methodological clarity: the simple recipe became a clean baseline for comparing masking strategy, target choice, model scale and data scale, while the open implementation made those comparisons easier to reproduce.
html.zh: 专家通常把 SimMIM 视为一项重要证据：强大的掩码图像预训练并不必然需要复杂离散目标或沉重重建模块。它的长期价值在于方法清晰，简洁方案成为比较遮挡策略、预测目标、模型规模和数据规模的干净基线，公开实现也提高了这些比较的可复现性。
